We've got the new mail application. We've got address book. We've got iChat. We've got iCal and now we have iSync. So iSync we think is going to be a really big deal and it's the start of something amazing. So the digital hub, we've added the phone, the Palm, and we've enhanced, uh, the iPod. And we've done that through these remarkable applications that we have written at Apple. iPhoto, iMovie, iTunes, iDVD, and now iSync. And with the remarkable batch of applications that come with Mac OS 10, the new address book, the new mail, new iChat, new Sherlock 3, new iCal. And this is this is the maturing of the vision that we put in place two years ago, which was our digital hub strategy. And all of the applications are now mostly out there. And you have my promise that we're going to keep working hard to make them even better and to continue to add wonderful new capabilities to the Mac. So thank you very, very much for coming today. Please go see our booth and, uh, we'll be talking to you soon. Thanks.
